disks.title: FreeDOS 1.3 LiveCD
disks.description: FreeDOS's official install and live CD, about 400MB. C: already boots without it. Use it to install more packages or to reinstall.
disks.license: Free software. FreeDOS's own release, unchanged.
disks.help:
It goes in drive D:. At the prompt:

  D:
  DIR

Eject it from the CD-ROM bay when you're done.

disks.title: CuteMouse 2.1 driver
disks.description: A freeware DOS mouse driver for this machine's PS/2 mouse. Nothing in DOS sees the mouse until it's loaded.
disks.license: GPL. Taken from the FreeDOS distribution this machine already ships.
disks.help:
A:\CTMOUSE /P      load it
  A:\MOUSETST        check it sees movement

To load it every boot: COPY A:\CTMOUSE.EXE C:\ and add
C:\CTMOUSE /P to AUTOEXEC.BAT.

disks.title: FreeDOS Games
disks.needs: 1.44MB drive A:, mouse driver for two of them
disks.description: Senet, Hangman, Eliza, Zmiy, ViTetris, Sudoku86 and BlockDrop. They run straight off the floppy.
disks.license: Free software (GPL, BSD or public domain, per program). See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
Run them straight from A:

  A:\SENET\SENET          the ancient Egyptian board game
  A:\HANGMAN\HANGMAN      hangman
  A:\ELIZA\ELIZA          the 1960s chatbot
  A:\ZMIY\ZMIY            a snake game
  A:\VITETRIS\TETRIS      Tetris
  A:\SUDOKU86\SUDOKU86    Sudoku. Needs the mouse driver
  A:\BLKDROP\BLKDROP      falling blocks. Needs the mouse driver

Load the mouse driver with  C:\FREEDOS\BIN\CTMOUSE /P

disks.title: FreeDOS Editors and Tools
disks.description: The TDE editor, Doszip Commander, e3 and the uHex hex editor.
disks.license: Free software (GPL, BSD or public domain, per program). See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
A:\TDE\TDEP FILE.TXT    TDE, a full-screen editor
  A:\DOSZIP\DZ            Doszip Commander. F10 quits
  A:\E3\E3 FILE.TXT        a small WordStar-style editor
  A:\UHEX\UHEX FILE        hex editor

disks.title: Pico and Freemacs
disks.description: Two more editors: Pico, from the Pine mail program, and Freemacs, an Emacs clone for DOS.
disks.license: GPL. See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
A:\PICO\PICO FILE.TXT   Ctrl-X saves and quits

Freemacs builds its .ED files the first time, so run it from
its own directory and answer Y:

  A:
  CD \FREEMACS
  EMACS

disks.title: DOS Navigator 2
disks.description: The open-source DOS Navigator, a Norton Commander-style file manager. Two disks that install to C:\DN2.
disks.help:
Put in disk 1, then:

  A:
  INSTALL

Swap disks when it asks, and give the drive a few seconds
before you press a key. Then:

  C:\DN2\DN

disks.title: Wing
disks.description: A Galaga-style shooter. Three disks that install to C:\WING.
disks.help:
Put in disk 1, then:

  A:
  INSTALL

Swap disks when it asks, and give the drive a few seconds
before you press a key. Then:

  C:
  CD \WING
  WING

disks.title: Bolitaire
disks.description: FreeCell for DOS, with a mouse. Runs off the floppy, though it loads faster from C:.
disks.help:
Load the mouse driver, then run it:

  C:\FREEDOS\BIN\CTMOUSE /P
  A:\BOLITARE\BOLITARE

It reads a lot of pictures, so it's quicker copied to C: first:

  XCOPY A:\BOLITARE C:\BOLITARE\ /S /E

disks.title: Commander Keen 1: Marooned on Mars
disks.description: The shareware episode, version 1.31, as Apogee put it on BBSes, with id's DEICE installer.
disks.license: Shareware. Apogee and id asked people to copy and pass on the unmodified episode.
disks.help:
A:
  INSTALL

Pick drive C and let it make \KEEN. Then:

  C:
  CD \KEEN
  KEEN1

disks.title: Wolfenstein 3-D
disks.description: The shareware episode, version 1.4. id's VENDOR.DOC says to fit as many pieces on a disk as will go, so on a 1.44MB disk it's all one.
disks.license: Shareware. id's VENDOR.DOC invites anyone to copy and distribute it.
disks.help:
A:
  INSTALL

Pick drive C and let it make \WOLF1. Then:

  C:
  CD \WOLF1
  WOLF3D

disks.title: DOOM
disks.description: Shareware episode 1, version 1.9, on id's own two-disk install set. Disk 1 is full to the last byte.
disks.license: Shareware. id marked it "PLEASE DISTRIBUTE!!!" and allowed free electronic distribution.
disks.help:
Put in disk 1, then:

  A:
  INSTALL

Pick drive C, let it make \DOOMS, and swap to disk 2 when it
asks. Give the drive a few seconds before you press Enter.
SETUP runs at the end. Then:

  C:
  CD \DOOMS
  DOOM
